retry_call.note: fn takes no arguments; bind them with a lambda or functools.partial. A first-attempt success never sleeps
_flaky raises on its first two calls then succeeds: the two failures are swallowed and the third call's value comes back
_always raises every call and counts them. Attempts exhausted: the last exception is re-raised unchanged, and 'call 3' shows all three attempts really happened
RuntimeError is not in retry_on, so it propagates immediately — 'call 1' proves no retry was attempted
